intro: A consultant resume built from engagements: the client's problem, what you did, and what it was worth to them.
tips: Describe each engagement as problem, action, result.
Give the value: savings, growth, or the decision made.
Name industries and the kinds of problems you solve.

basics.name: Benjamin Clarke
basics.label: Management Consultant
basics.summary: Management consultant with six years in strategy and operations for retail, health and government clients. I turn ambiguous problems into decisions, and help clients carry them out.

work.name: Harbourside Partners
highlights: Led a cost review for a national retailer that found A$45m in savings; A$30m delivered in year one.
Designed the operating model for a new state health agency of 1,500 staff.
Manage teams of three to five consultants on each engagement.

work.name: Deloitte
highlights: Worked on 12 engagements in operations and supply chain.
Built the network model that a grocer used to choose the site of a new distribution centre.
